name: ElevenLabs Eleven v4
note: Top of the speech board. Up to 5,000 characters per request with stability and similarity controls.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
note: 30 built-in voices, style instructions, and inline laughs and sighs. Artificial Analysis lists Google's own API at about $0.0165 per 1,000 characters, so calling Google directly is cheaper.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
note: 30 voices, one speaker or two-speaker dialogue. Google's own API is listed at about $0.011 per 1,000 characters.

name: ElevenLabs v3
note: Previous ElevenLabs flagship. Eleven v4 now ranks higher for less.

name: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD
note: High-quality speech with many voice options.

name: xAI TTS
note: The cheapest well-ranked voice on fal. Expressive and realistic.

name: ElevenLabs Turbo v2.5
note: Fast and streaming-capable, but now beaten by cheaper models.

name: ElevenLabs Multilingual v2
note: Older multilingual model. Costs 3 times Gemini Flash-Lite and ranks far lower.

name: Kokoro (American English)
note: Small open model (82M parameters). On fal it costs more than xAI TTS and ranks lower.

name: ElevenLabs Eleven v4 Turbo
note: Faster Eleven v4 with audio tags and IPA pronunciation. Not on the Artificial Analysis board yet.
